b.plotted: solid lines, one hue per direction (blue text->image, orange image->text), lighter = weaker target: upper = the paper's map the model scores highest for its text (paper recipe; a3 paper_upper), multi = every map of the paper is a target (text->image: hit when any of its maps is in the top k of all maps, a3 oracle_any_true; image->text: every map ranks the 298 texts, a3 per_image), lower = the map it scores lowest (a3 worst_image); dashed lines in the same colour = chance of that curve; legend: AUC (chance AUC)
b.chance: dashed, one per curve in its colour: a3's null of the same rule (recall_curves.csv 'chance', bounds_metrics.csv chance_recall_curve_auc): every text is given to another paper (a derangement), then the same best / worst / any-map selection and ranking are applied; mean of 20 derangements. Not k/N: upper and lower pick the target with the similarities they rank and multi text->image counts any of the paper's maps, so only multi image->text (one text per map among 298) is the diagonal.
b.asymmetry: upper (paper recipe): both directions rank the same 298 x 298 similarity matrix (one map per paper, same exclusions), text->image along its rows and image->text along its columns, so the pools are matched and the gap is not an artefact: a few generic abstracts are close to most maps (text hubs; one abstract is the nearest text for 38 of the 298 maps, 8 abstracts are in the top 5 of >= 10 % of the maps vs 1 map in the top 5 of >= 10 % of the abstracts), which pushes the true abstract down when a map ranks the texts but is a constant within a text's own ranking of the maps; subtracting each abstract's mean similarity to all 3,074 maps lifts image->text from 0.787 to 0.842 and leaves text->image at 0.847 (check on the a3 latents, variant released). multi: the pools differ by definition (text->image: any of the paper's maps among all 3,074 is a hit; image->text: each map ranks the 298 abstracts with one hit), hence 0.87 vs 0.63 (chance 0.76 vs 0.51, 0.50 in expectation).

d.labels: full class names on both axes (columns at 60 degrees); cells: % of the true class (rows), empty = 0
